snippet.title: Lobsterpunk Trailer - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3414920/Lobsterpunk/

Lockpick your way through an abandoned city powered solely by the combustion of lobsters. Bring the dead machinery one last breath of life before their steel forms lay cold forever. As you do, see the memories of the last man on earth, and how familiar that might feel, however foreign the setting.

Credits:
Music by: Johnny Hernandez
https://lnk.bio/RaCcss
Levi portrayed by: Aiden Lawrence
https://www.instagram.com/thelegendarycheetah
Ellie Portrayed By: Archivist
https://sites.google.com/view/archivistportfolio/home?authuser=3
Developed by: Carter Diaz de Leon
https://www.instagram.com/dashiba8
